title: Bound completion recovery scale across cumulative required-child breadth
outcome: The completion recovery scale gate covers the maximum supported cumulative required-child breadth, not only one decomposition call.
acceptance: The scale fixture builds at least 128 required children for one parent through repeated decompositions and completion recovery remains inside an explicit derived decode budget.

completion.summary: Extended completion recovery coverage to the maximum cumulative 128-child breadth, then replaced the history-linear discriminator with compact barrier revisions and grouped doctor waiver replay.
